questions.promptZh: 看到一个地方，你最想知道的是——
questions.promptEn: At a new spot, the first thing you want to know is —

options.labelZh: 这儿好不好拍、氛围如何
options.labelEn: Is it photogenic? What’s the vibe?

options.labelZh: 有没有什么有意思的小故事
谁在这儿待过、哪本书哪部电影写过它
options.labelEn: Who lived here, which book or film featured it

questions.promptEn: Before you set out, your itinerary is —

options.labelEn: Down to the stop order and time slots

questions.promptEn: Your ideal way to explore is —

options.labelEn: With one or two close friends

questions.promptZh: 面对需要花钱的体验项目，你——

options.labelEn: If it’s free to see, I won’t pay
Paying for experience is only natural

profiles.taglineZh: 你负责享受，剩下的交给我。
profiles.taglineEn: You enjoy; I’ll handle the rest.
profiles.descZh: 你是那种把所有人的行程都安排明白、还能顺便订到最难订的位子的人。文化、效率、社交、体验，你全都要，而且能拿到。
profiles.descEn: You’re the one who nails everyone’s itinerary and still lands the hardest reservation. Culture, efficiency, socializing, experience — you want it all, and you get it.

profiles.taglineZh: 跟着我走，一分钱不多花。
profiles.taglineEn: Follow me — not a euro wasted.
profiles.descZh: 你是朋友圈里那个「知道最多冷知识又最会省钱」的团长，路线排得明明白白，还专挑有梗又免费的点。
profiles.descEn: You’re the group leader who knows the most trivia and spends the least — tight routes, all the free-and-fun spots.

profiles.descZh: 你享受独自的深度体验，愿意为品质买单，但不需要人陪。安静、考究、有内容，是你的关键词。
profiles.descEn: You savor deep solo experiences and pay for quality, no company needed. Quiet, refined, substantial.

profiles.taglineZh: 一杯咖啡，我能坐一整天。
profiles.descZh: 你对典故、人物关系、文本互文有近乎偏执的兴趣，喜欢按图索骥地走一条有纵深的线，独处、省钱、读得越深越开心。
profiles.descEn: You’re near-obsessive about allusions, relationships and textual echoes; you love walking a route with real depth — solo, thrifty, and happiest the deeper it goes.

profiles.taglineEn: If it’s cool, we’re in — don’t ask for a plan.
profiles.descZh: 你有文化底子但讨厌被行程绑住，走到哪玩到哪，爱热闹也舍得花，蒙马特画家们的即兴人生就是你。
profiles.descEn: Cultured but allergic to fixed schedules; you go where the fun is, love a crowd and don’t mind spending. The improvised life of the Montmartre painters is you.

profiles.descZh: 你迷恋旧日故事和穷艺术家的浪漫，喜欢跟人聊天听掌故，钱不多但过得有滋味，海明威的巴黎就是你的巴黎。
profiles.descEn: You love old stories and the romance of the broke artist; you chat, collect anecdotes, and live richly on little. Hemingway’s Paris is yours.

profiles.descZh: 你偏爱安静而高级的文化体验，随性但讲究，愿意为一杯好茶、一间私人美术馆停下脚步。
profiles.descEn: You favor quiet, high-end culture — casual yet discerning, happy to stop for a fine tea or a private gallery.

profiles.taglineZh: 和名人们，静静待一会儿。
profiles.taglineEn: A quiet while among the famous dead.
profiles.descZh: 你喜欢清晨的公墓、无人的小美术馆，一个人安静地与历史相处，不赶时间也不花钱。
profiles.descEn: You like dawn cemeteries and empty little museums — communing quietly with history, unhurried and unspending.

profiles.descZh: 你不太在乎典故，但极其在乎体验和排面，计划周密、出手大方，米其林和游船晚宴是你的主场。
profiles.descEn: You don’t care much for allusions but care intensely about experience and status — well-planned, generous, at home with Michelin and dinner cruises.

profiles.descZh: 你追求高效的打卡体验，路线安排得像时刻表，爱和人一起拍照发图，但不为深度内容停留太久。
profiles.descEn: You chase efficient check-ins, routes tight as a timetable — you love group photos, but won’t linger for deep content.

profiles.descZh: 你享受精心安排的独处，愿意为舒适买单，一个人沿河慢走、找家精品酒店喝下午茶，谁也不打扰。
profiles.descEn: You enjoy carefully arranged solitude and pay for comfort — a slow riverside walk, afternoon tea at a boutique hotel, nobody bothering you.

profiles.taglineEn: Head for the edge of the city.
profiles.descZh: 你规划清楚但不爱人多，喜欢沿运河、去城市远端的公园，找免费的观景点，一个人吹风。
profiles.descEn: You plan clearly but avoid crowds — canal towpaths, far-flung parks, free viewpoints, wind in your face, alone.

profiles.descZh: 你随性、爱热闹、出手阔绰，最开心的事是招呼一桌人吃吃喝喝，气氛比景点重要。
profiles.descEn: Spontaneous, sociable and generous — your favorite thing is treating a table of friends; atmosphere beats sightseeing.

profiles.descZh: 你走到哪聊到哪，不做攻略也不花大钱，蒙马特街头的十五分钟人生，就是你的日常。
profiles.descEn: You chat everywhere, skip the planning and the big spending — the fifteen-minute street life of Montmartre is your everyday.

profiles.taglineEn: Find a seat, stay all afternoon.
profiles.descZh: 你来巴黎就是为了躺平，公园草坪、露天咖啡、酒店大堂酒廊，舒服最重要，没人赶你就赢了。
profiles.descEn: You came to Paris to do nothing — park lawns, terrace cafés, hotel lounges. Comfort is everything; if nobody rushes you, you win.

profiles.taglineZh: 盲盒式漫游，走到哪算哪。
profiles.descZh: 你没有计划也不想有，一个人随机在街区里游荡，跳蚤市场、街头装置、小众甜品店，惊喜比目标更重要。
profiles.descEn: No plan and no wish for one — you drift solo through neighborhoods; flea markets, street installations, obscure pâtisseries. Surprise beats destination.
